sentences.text: G.Nagaraja Setty Nagaraja, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on

Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3793 Of 2020
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C to quash the proceedings in Crime No.187 of 2020 dated 16.7.2020 of Bangarupalem Police Station, Chittoor District against the petitioners/A1 to A3 for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 328, 270, 273, 420, 120-B r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 24(1) r/w 27 of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act,
2003, Section 3 of Epidemic Disease Act, Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act and Section 4 of Gutkha Pan Masala Prohibition Act.

entities.text:
Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act,
2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard the counsel for the petitioners and the Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsel submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

In view of the above and in terms of the aforementioned order, this Criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in Crime No.187 of 2020 dated 16.7.2020 of Bangarupalem Police Station, Chittoor District are hereby quashed.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall also closed.

The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order dated 27.08.2018 in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch to this order.
_______________ D.RAMESH, J.
Date: 10.09.2020 Rd THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE D.RAMESH Criminal Petition No.3793 OF 2020 Dated: 10.09.2020 Rd G.Nagaraja Setty Nagaraja, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 10 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105264929/
